## What is still open
- Elad approved #1412 but wants one audit event per batch (id range, count, from/to KEK), not just the final summary, for PCI 10.2 traceability — that's what stands between you and the merge, and Avi wants it merged by Monday so the rotation can run Tuesday night [3].
- The prod run is set for Tue 24/11, 22:00–23:30 IL time, Elad on call with you; the only fallback is Thu 26/11, since the PCI change freeze starts 1/12 [6].
- Shira needs two things by Wed 25/11 for Victor at Ardent, ahead of the on-site: the exported audit log of the prod rotation run and the signed change ticket [5].

## What changed
- Avi's LGTM is conditional on Elad's per-batch audit point being in [3].
- Dependabot opened a tokio 1.41.0 → 1.41.1 bump (fixes a `JoinSet::try_join_next` panic) [4].

## What you did
- Built the card-vault KEK rotation job: re-wraps every token DEK under `vault-kek-2026`, with legacy v1 envelopes mapped explicitly to `vault-kek-2022` instead of resurrecting the old alias; staging dry run cleared all 1,204,880 tokens with 0 failures, and the job ends with an audit record; opened as #1412 [1].
- Wrote the prod runbook with pre-checks, dry run against the read replica, the real run under `--pause-on-error`, verification, and the failure path: nothing to roll back, resume with `--from-id` [2].
